items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: He's his boy, Norman's uncle, you see.

ctx.x: Well who was the drummer named Maurice? Manuel Alexander, I mentioned his name. No, but there's a drummer named Maurice. From here. From here, huh? What? I'm not confused. I must be confused. You're confused. Yeah, I'm thinking he's a saxophone player or something. There's seven pieces we had. Oh yeah. Something, I must have them all mixed up, you know. I hear so many names in a day it's hard to keep them all straight. Yes sir.

Well there's a drummer in the island by the name of Norbert Maurice. This fellow, Paul Maurice, would play clarinet with our orchestra. He's his boy, Norman's uncle, you see. He used to play drum, he too, but he lives in the islands now.
What about the Supreme Band? When was it going?
